summary: A cosy 2D side-scrolling fishing game that runs entirely in the browser: no build step, no libraries, no image or sound files.
howItWorks: One requestAnimationFrame loop updates the world and then redraws everything on a single canvas. The time step is capped, so coming back to a background tab doesn't make things jump.
The sea is 12,000px wide and gets deeper to the right. The camera follows the boat sideways and the hook downwards, and only what's on screen is drawn.
Fish, the girl, dolphins and whales are drawn in code with canvas paths and gradients, so the whole game is about 65 KB.
New fish appear just off screen: the game picks a depth first, then a species that lives at that depth, so the whole water column stays busy.
Every sound is generated on the fly from oscillators and filtered noise.

features.name: Procedural vector art
features.what: Every species is one entry in a table: size, speed, depth range, rarity and a draw function. Adding a fish means adding one entry.

features.name: Synthesised sound effects
features.what: Splashes, piano notes, chomps, dolphin chirps, a looping rain sound and thunder from the Web Audio API, with a mute toggle remembered in localStorage.

features.name: Creature AI state machine
features.what: Each fish is in one state at a time (swim, flee, chase, approach, nibble, bite, hooked, in the air), and each state has its own movement.

features.name: Predator and prey chases
features.what: Out in deep water, big fish now and then pick a much smaller one nearby and chase it. The prey dodges, and is either eaten or gets away.

features.name: Camera that follows the action, with parallax
features.what: Smoothed camera following the boat and then the hook; distant islands and clouds scroll more slowly to give a sense of depth.

features.name: Weather cycle
features.what: Rain fades in and out on a timer and is likelier further out to sea: the sky colour blends, raindrops ripple the surface, the waves get choppier, and heavy rain brings lightning.

features.name: Animated character with moods
features.what: A girl drawn in code who blinks, turns the reel, puts her hood up in the rain, looks alert when a fish bites and celebrates a catch.

features.name: Collection saved in the browser
features.what: A Fishdex of caught species and best sizes, kept in localStorage. Every read and write is wrapped so the game still works in private browsing.

features.name: Zero-dependency dev server
features.what: A 20-line Node static file server with path-traversal protection, for running ES modules locally.
